Currently, it only appears when the [[Brain Rot]] modifier is activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, replacing every modern [[Normal]] and [[Abnormal]] variant, or with its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It has a decent amount of health and an above average speed. ==Appearance== The '''Toilet''' is a white toilet. It has a pale skinned head coming out of it, which used the {{RLinkC|86487700|Man Face}}. ==Headache Headquarters Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Headache Headquarters]] is listed instead. *Strong early-game towers like the [[Militant]], [[Golden Scout]] or [[Golden Cowboy]] are very effective here. **Towers with area of effect capabilities, like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Mortar]], can also be useful here. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Toilet.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseToilet.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, original animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Skibidi Tower Defense Simulator Episode 1 (TOILETS)|'''Toilet''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Development Videos}} ToiletEnemyAnimation.gif|'''Toilet''' on a development video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ToiletIconIG.png|'''Toilet''' on its [[Index]] icon. ManFace.png|'''Toilet's''' face. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Toilet''' enemy was inspired by the ''Skibidi Toilet'' series, with the '''Toilet''' being based on the [[w:c:skibidi-toilet:Normal Skibidi Toilet|regular Skibidi Toilet]]. ==Update History== *'''1 April 2024''' - [[v1.17.2]] **'''Toilet''' added. *'''8 April 2024''' - [[v1.18.0]]b **'''Toilet''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Toilet''' re-added, exclusively to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **{{Bug}} Has no neck in the [[Index]]. *'''1 April 2025''' - [[v1.58.0|v1.58.1a]] **'''Toilet''' now appears in [[Headache Headquarters]] as part of [[April Fools 2025 Event]]. *'''8 April 2025''' - [[v1.59.0|v1.59.6b]] **'''Toilet''' no longer appears in [[Headache Headquarters]], now only appears in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''1 April 2026''' - [[v1.86.0|v1.86.5a]] **'''Toilet''' now appears in [[Headache Headquarters]] as part of [[Aprilini Foolsini Eventini]]. *'''8 April 2026''' - [[v1.88.0|v1.88.2a]] **'''Toilet''' no longer appears in [[Headache Headquarters]], now only appears in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{HeadacheHQ|Start|N/A|Toilet|Wave 1|[[Streamer]]|Wave 2}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
